numerical_failure.observed_behavior: With missing="drop" (or "conservative") and NaNs in x, acf() computes the Bartlett confidence-interval variance and Ljung-Box q-statistic using nobs=len(x), the length including NaNs, so the confint half-width and qstat are too small. Reproducer values: confint half-width at lag 1 drop=0.098000 vs reference 0.138590; qstat at lag 1 drop=0.795745 vs reference 0.400857.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The confidence interval and q-statistic should use the non-missing sample size (np.sum(~np.isnan(x))) as nobs, matching acf on the NaN-dropped data with missing="none". Reference confint half-width at lag 1 is 0.138590 and reference qstat at lag 1 is 0.400857.
trigger_conditions: acf called with missing="drop" or missing="conservative"
qstat=True and/or confidence intervals requested (alpha set)

input_output_examples.input: x_with_nans = concatenate(rng.standard_normal(200) with seed 0, np.full(200, nan)); acf(x_with_nans, nlags=10, qstat=True, alpha=0.05, missing="drop", fft=False), lag 1

category_specific_evidence: Property violated: the Bartlett confint variance and Ljung-Box qstat use nobs=len(x), including NaNs, while acovf's divisor for missing='drop' or 'conservative' is the non-missing count; the correct effective n should be the non-missing count.
PR#10017 reproducer: confint half-width at lag 1 is 0.098000 with drop versus reference 0.138590 (dropped by hand); qstat at lag 1 is 0.795745 with drop versus reference 0.400857.
Diff at _stattools.py changes varacf = 1.0 / len(x) to 1.0 / nobs in the non-Bartlett branch of acf.
Commit states that with one leading NaN prepended to realgdp (n_raw=204, n_eff=203), nobs=203 reproduces the Stata reference Q1 and Bartlett bounds in results_corrgram.csv, while nobs=204 does not.
Discussion patch sets nobs = int(np.sum(~np.isnan(x))) when missing is 'drop' or 'conservative'.
The re-enabled test test_qstat_drop asserts res_drop[2][:40] matches qstat at DECIMAL_3, and new tests test_confint_drop and test_confint_conservative check centered confint at DECIMAL_8.
Reproducer uses rng default_rng(0), 200 standard normal values plus 200 NaNs, nlags=10, alpha=0.05, fft=False, comparing missing='drop' against missing='none' on the dropped array.
Reviewer note: nobs == 0 should raise a ValueError stating all values were removed.
reproduction_risks: The reproducer code in the PR body is truncated, so the exact comparison assertions are not fully visible.
The reference values 0.138590 and 0.400857 were computed by hand in the PR and are not independently verified in the passages.
Passages do not give the dtype of the input arrays.
The Stata reference values come from results_corrgram.csv and are referenced but not reproduced in the passages.
The discussion patch's nobs==0 guard is only requested and not shown implemented.
